title: Generic vanishing subschemes of codimension three
summary: We classify geometrically nondegenerate GV subschemes of codimension three in indecomposable principally polarized complex abelian varieties of dimension $g\ge6$. Every such subscheme is a translate of $\pm W_{g-3}(C)$ in the Jacobian of a smooth curve $C$. The proof studies the theta-dual surface: tangent cones and theta Hessians give a curve summand in the singular case, while Hodge gradings and characteristic cycles give one in the smooth case.
